iti92:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti92:2.1: saṅghāṭikaṇṇe ce’pi bhikkhave bhikkhu gahetvā piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddho assa, pāde pādaṃ nikkhipanto.
iti92:2.2: so ca hoti abhijjhālu kāmesu tibbasārāgo byāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo.
iti92:2.3: atha kho so ārakā’va mayhaṃ, ahaṃ ca tassa.
iti92:2.5: dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu na passati
iti92:3.1: yojanasate ce’pi so bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya
iti92:3.2: so ca hoti anabhijjhālu kāmesu na tibbasārāgo abyāpannacitto appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo upaṭṭhitassati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo.
iti92:3.3: atha kho so santikeva mayhaṃ, ahaṃ ca tassa.
iti92:3.5: dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu passati
iti92:7.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
